name: banking77
instructions: Which intent does this customer message sent to a digital bank's support chat express? Pick the single most specific intent that matches what the customer wants or is reporting.

criteria.activate_my_card: Asks how to activate a new card they received / card activation not done yet.
criteria.age_limit: Asks about the minimum age or age requirement to open or use an account (e.g. can my child have one).
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Questions about using Apple Pay or Google Pay with the account/card, adding the card to a mobile wallet, or topping up via Apple Pay.
criteria.atm_support: Asks where ATMs are, which ATMs can be used, or how to find a compatible ATM (general ATM questions, not a problem with a specific withdrawal).
criteria.automatic_top_up: Asks about setting up, enabling, disabling or fixing automatic/recurring top-ups of the account.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money was sent to the customer's own account by bank transfer (e.g. from a UK account) but their balance has not updated / the incoming transfer does not show up or has not reached their account.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposit was made but the balance has not updated / deposit not showing.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary or make a transfer to a particular recipient; beneficiary is rejected or not allowed.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel/reverse a transfer or transaction they made, or sent money to the wrong account/recipient by mistake.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring soon; asks about renewal, replacement or the expiry date of the card.
criteria.card_acceptance: Asks where the card is accepted (merchants, shops, countries, online), or whether it is accepted somewhere.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived / is overdue; asks where it is, how to track it, or reports it not received (stress is on the card being late or missing).
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: Asks how long card delivery takes, when it will arrive, express delivery, delivery options, how the card will be sent, or delivery cost/fees for a new card.
criteria.card_linking: Asks how to link or connect an existing card to the app/account (adding another card to the app).
criteria.card_not_working: Their card does not work or something is wrong with the card (e.g. tried it a few times in different places and it didn't work), without a more specific cause such as contactless, PIN, or a clearly declined payment.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Was charged a fee on a card payment (e.g. fee for paying by card, or abroad).
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: Sees a card payment/purchase/transaction on the account they did not make or do not recognise (the default for 'a payment I didn't make').
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Card payment in a foreign currency was converted at the wrong exchange rate.
criteria.card_swallowed: The ATM machine swallowed / kept / ate their card, or they need to retrieve a card stuck in an ATM.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Was charged a fee for a cash withdrawal, or asks about fees for withdrawing cash.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Sees a cash withdrawal or cash on the account they did not make or do not recognise, or someone withdrew money with their card.
criteria.change_pin: Asks how to change or set their PIN, or reset a PIN they forgot.
criteria.compromised_card: Card or details may have been compromised, used by someone else, or fraud/unauthorised use; wants card secured (not simply lost/stolen).
criteria.country_support: Asks which countries the service/account is available in or supported.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined or refused.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Sees a direct debit payment they do not recognise or did not authorise.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Asks about limits or restrictions of disposable cards.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Asks how to change/update personal details such as name, address, phone number, email, date of birth.
criteria.exchange_charge: Asks about fees/charges for exchanging currencies.
criteria.exchange_rate: Asks what exchange rate is used or how it is determined/where to see it (general question about rates).
criteria.exchange_via_app: Asks how to exchange currency in the app, or reports an exchange problem there (the how-to/mechanics of exchanging).
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: Sees an unexpected small extra amount (e.g. an extra £1/$1/€1, including a small pending one) or unexplained extra charge on the statement.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed / did not go through.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Asks which fiat currencies are supported, can be held or exchanged, including 'can I exchange to/hold EUR/USD/...' for a specific currency.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Asks how to get / create a disposable virtual card.
criteria.get_physical_card: Asks how to get a physical card (wants one, how to obtain it), or has not yet received their PIN. Not for a card stuck in an ATM.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Asks about getting an additional / spare / second card.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Asks how to get / create a (non-disposable) virtual card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Their card is lost or has been stolen.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Their phone is lost or has been stolen and they worry about the account/app.
criteria.order_physical_card: Wants to order a physical card / asks how to order one.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot their passcode / app login code, or needs to reset it.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is showing as pending, or has not gone through yet; asks why or how long.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal shows as pending.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is pending / not yet completed.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is pending / still processing / in progress / not yet completed or cleared.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked (too many wrong attempts) or card blocked due to PIN entries; wants to unblock.
criteria.receiving_money: Asks how to receive money into the account, or how someone can pay them (account details, IBAN).
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: Expected a refund but it has not shown up in the account.
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund, wants to return an item or cancel a purchase/payment made to a merchant, or asks how to request a refund.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was already reverted / returned / cancelled on its own (merchant or bank reversed it; money came back or payment disappeared); not the customer asking to cancel.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Asks which cards (and currencies) can be used to top up or are supported by the account.
criteria.terminate_account: Wants to close / delete / terminate their account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Asks about fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Asks about fees/charges for topping up by card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Asks about topping up with cash or cheque.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed / did not work.
criteria.top_up_limits: Asks about limits on top-ups (maximum amounts).
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted / reversed / money returned after topping up.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Asks how to top up using a card, or reports problems topping up by card (not about fees or failure).
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Was charged twice for the same transaction / duplicate payment.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Was charged a fee for a transfer.
criteria.transfer_into_account: Asks how to transfer money into their account from another bank/account.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer the customer sent to someone else (or to another account of theirs) has not arrived / is not there yet; the recipient has not received it.
criteria.transfer_timing: Asks how long transfers take, or how much longer to wait for a transfer / when it will arrive, without saying it is pending.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Unable to verify their identity / identity verification keeps failing or is rejected.
criteria.verify_my_identity: Asks how to verify their identity / what is needed for identity verification.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Asks about verifying the source of funds / proving where the money comes from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Asks about verifying a top-up, or a top-up verification code/step.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Their virtual card is not working.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Asks whether the card is Visa or Mastercard / which network, can choose, or says they want to get a Visa or Mastercard card.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Asks why identity verification is required / needed.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: Received the wrong amount of cash from an ATM withdrawal (too little/much).
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawal (abroad) was converted at the wrong or too-high exchange rate, or amount of cash received seems off because of the rate.
